_source: Seed Scenario 2 in docs/claimflow-luo-playbook.md, Step 3.2 — the backup demo case, used to show adaptability and multilingual reply drafting (Slovak).
complaintText: Dobrý deň, objednal som si veľkosť L, ale v balíku bolo tričko s visačkou XL. Chcem ho vymeniť za správnu veľkosť.

evidenceCheck.note: Photo of the neck tag showing size XL is complete evidence for a wrong-item case (Complaint Guide 5.1).

resolutionProposal.rationale: Wrong-item complaint, warehouse picking error (ordered L, shipped XL), evidence complete. Policy requires shipping the correct item and issuing a prepaid return label (Complaint Guide 5.2). This is an internal fulfilment discrepancy, not a carrier fault, so no carrier claim is generated.

policySource.excerpt: 5.2 Confirmed wrong-item cases are resolved by shipping the correct item and issuing a prepaid return label for the incorrect item.

customerReplyDraft.text: Ospravedlňujeme sa za zámenu veľkosti. Správnu veľkosť L vám posielame ešte dnes a e-mailom sme vám zaslali predplatenú návratkovú etiketu na tričko s veľkosťou XL.
customerReplyDraft.internalSummaryEn: Wrong-item case (ordered L, received XL), complete evidence (tag photo), warehouse picking error. Correct item to be shipped plus prepaid return label. No carrier claim — internal fulfilment discrepancy only.

internalFlag.note: Flagged internally for the warehouse team; no external carrier or supplier claim, per docs/claimflow-luo-playbook.md Step 3.2.
